from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,time,json
w=Path(__file__).parent;lab=w.parent
base=['ssh','-F',str(w/'guest_ssh_config'),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=8']
peers=json.loads((w/'boot.json').read_text())
ports=' or '.join(f'{side} = :{port}' for side in ('sport','dport') for port in (37710,37711,40000,40001,22230))
chain='sudo nft -j -a list chain inet sshpool_ssi_lab input'
comment='sshpool-pf28-workspace'
def read(node,command):
 return subprocess.check_output(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}',command],timeout=30).decode()
def idle(node):
 assert read(node,'cat /etc/machine-id').strip()==['bed141ceb5a94840930beead90b4d3a8','97609053a4db470a8a9fd24d2d2af76b'][node]
 assert read(node,'uname -r').strip()==peers[node]['kernel']
 names=read(node,'ps -eo comm=').splitlines()
 assert not [x for x in names if x.strip().startswith(('qemu-system-','memfd:sshpool','kvm-dsm/','dsm-conn/'))]
 assert not read(node,'sudo cat /sys/kernel/tracing/kprobe_events; sudo find /sys/kernel/tracing/instances -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1').strip()
 deadline=time.monotonic()+180
 while read(node,f"ss -H -tan '( {ports} )'").strip():
  if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise RuntimeError('TCP states not drained')
  time.sleep(2)
 assert int(read(node,'df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1').strip())>=64*1024*1024
for mode in ('control','pair'):
 for node in (0,1):idle(node)
 before=[json.loads(read(n,chain)) for n in (0,1)]
 assert all(before[n]==json.loads((w/f'node{n}-before-firewall.json').read_text()) for n in (0,1))
 active=[]
 label=f'pf28-steal-{mode}-a'
 cursors=[read(n,'sudo journalctl -k -b -n 0 --show-cursor --no-pager').split('-- cursor: ',1)[1].strip() for n in (0,1)]
 try:
  if mode=='pair':
   for node in (0,1):
    peer=peers[1-node]['address']
    rule=f'insert rule inet sshpool_ssi_lab input ip saddr {peer} tcp dport {{ 37710, 37711 }} accept comment "{comment}"\n'
    subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','sudo nft -f -'],input=rule.encode(),check=True,timeout=15)
  active=[json.loads(read(n,chain)) for n in (0,1)]
  args=['python3','-u','/Users/zjarlin/projects/sshpool/scripts/ssi-lab/probe-pvclock.py','--ssh-config',str(w/'guest_ssh_config'),'--host','ssi-lab-1','--require-kernel',peers[0]['kernel'],'--worker','ssi/probe-records','--kind','steal','--log',str(w/(label+'.jsonl'))]
  if mode=='pair':args+=['--host','ssi-lab-2','--peer',peers[0]['address'],'--peer',peers[1]['address']]
  with (w/(label+'-stderr.log')).open('x') as err:
   result=subprocess.run(args,stderr=err,timeout=240)
  print('controller exit',mode,result.returncode,flush=True)
  lines=(w/(label+'.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()
  final=json.loads(lines[-1].removeprefix('PVCLOCK_RESULT '))
  assert final['checks']==8 and final['errors']==[],final
  for node in (0,1):
   import shlex
   (w/(label+f'-node{node}-host.log')).write_text(read(node,'sudo journalctl -k -b --no-pager --after-cursor='+shlex.quote(cursors[node])))
 finally:
  for node in (0,1):
   current=json.loads(read(node,chain))
   for value in current['nftables']:
    rule=value.get('rule',{})
    if rule.get('comment')==comment:
     subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}',f'sudo nft delete rule inet sshpool_ssi_lab input handle {rule["handle"]}'],check=True,timeout=15)
  after=[json.loads(read(n,chain)) for n in (0,1)]
  assert before==after
  (w/(label+'-firewall.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'before':before,'active':active,'after':after,'restored_exactly':True},indent=2)+'\n')
 for node in (0,1):idle(node)
 print('workspace processes, trace, TCP and firewall clean',mode,flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,time,json,hashlib
work=Path(__file__).parent;lab=work.parent
nodes=json.loads((work/'pf29/boot.json').read_text())
base=['ssh','-F',str(work/'pf29/guest_ssh_config'),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=4']
def read(row,address,command,timeout=30):
 return subprocess.check_output(base+['-o','HostName='+address,f'ssi-lab-{row["node"]+1}',command],timeout=timeout,stderr=subprocess.PIPE).decode()
def check(row,address):
 assert read(row,address,'cat /etc/machine-id').strip()==row['machine_id']
 names=read(row,address,'ps -eo comm=').splitlines()
 assert not [x for x in names if x.strip().startswith(('qemu-system-','kvm-dsm/','dsm-conn/','memfd:sshpool','kvm-nx-lpage-'))]
 assert not read(row,address,'sudo cat /sys/kernel/tracing/kprobe_events; sudo find /sys/kernel/tracing/instances -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1').strip()
 assert json.loads(read(row,address,'sudo nft -j -a list chain inet sshpool_ssi_lab input'))==json.loads((work/f'node{row["node"]}-before-firewall.json').read_text())
 ports=' or '.join(f'{side} = :{port}' for side in ('sport','dport') for port in (37710,37711,40000,40001,22230))
 assert not read(row,address,f"ss -H -tan '( {ports} )'").strip()
records=[]
for row in nodes:
 n=row['node'];address=row['address'];check(row,address)
 assert read(row,address,'uname -r').strip()==row['kernel']
 assert read(row,address,'sudo cat /boot/grub/grub.cfg')==(work/'pf29'/f'node{n}-grub.cfg').read_text()
 assert not read(row,address,'sudo grub-editenv /boot/grub/grubenv list').strip()
 read(row,address,'sudo systemctl reboot')
 print('stock reboot requested',n,flush=True)
 deadline=time.monotonic()+300
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  try:
   actual=read(row,row['stock'],'uname -r; cat /etc/machine-id',timeout=8).splitlines()
   if actual==['6.8.0-147-generic',row['machine_id']]:break
  except (subprocess.CalledProcessError,subprocess.TimeoutExpired):pass
  time.sleep(3)
 else:raise RuntimeError('stock observation expired; do not reset')
 address=row['stock'];check(row,address)
 entry=read(row,address,'sudo cat /etc/grub.d/41_sshpool_pf29_steal')
 assert entry==(work/'pf29'/f'node{n}-entry').read_text()
 (work/f'node{n}-removed-pf29-entry').write_text(entry)
 read(row,address,'sudo rm /etc/grub.d/41_sshpool_pf29_steal && sudo update-grub',timeout=60)
 cfg=read(row,address,'sudo cat /boot/grub/grub.cfg');assert cfg==(work/f'node{n}-before-grub.cfg').read_text()
 assert 'set default="Advanced options for Ubuntu>Ubuntu, with Linux 6.8.0-147-generic"' in cfg
 assert read(row,address,'readlink /lib').strip()=='usr/lib'
 assert not read(row,address,'sudo grub-editenv /boot/grub/grubenv list').strip()
 hashes=read(row,address,'sudo sha256sum /boot/*generic /boot/*pf*',timeout=60)
 assert hashes==(work/f'node{n}-before-boot.sha256').read_text()
 record={'node':n,'kernel':actual[0],'identity_matches':True,'old_boot_files_unchanged':True,'boot_hash_manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(hashes.encode()).hexdigest(),'grub_config_unchanged':True,'firewall_matches_original':True,'lib_target':'usr/lib','grub_environment':'','remaining_processes':[],'remaining_trace_instances':[],'remaining_experiment_tcp':[],'stock_grub_default':True,'pf29_grub_entry_removed':True,'pf29_boot_artifacts_preserved':True}
 records.append(record)
 (work/'restoration-pf29.json').write_text(json.dumps({'nodes':records},indent=2)+'\n')
 print('stock identity, hashes, firewall and cleanup verified',n,flush=True)
